__else__.description: Currently, only setting this to `__NULL__` is supported. This will remove all other streams.

__alias__.title: Stream Alias

__else__.description: Currently, only setting this to `__NULL__` is supported. This will remove all other properties from the stream.

__filter__.title: Filter
__filter__.description: Filter out records from a stream. A string expression which must evaluate to `true` to include the record, or `false` to exclude it. Filter expressions should be wrapped in `bool()` to ensure proper type conversion.

__key_properties__.title: Key Properties
__key_properties__.description: Primary key properties for the stream.

__source__.description: Create a new stream from this source stream.

stream_maps.title: Stream Maps
stream_maps.description: Config object for stream maps capability. For more information check out [Stream Maps](https://sdk.meltano.com/en/latest/stream_maps.html).

stream_map_config.title: User Stream Map Configuration
stream_map_config.description: User-defined config values to be used within map expressions.

seed.title: Faker Seed
seed.description: Value to seed the Faker generator for deterministic output: https://faker.readthedocs.io/en/master/#seeding-the-generator

locale.title: Faker Locale
locale.description: One or more LCID locale strings to produce localized output for: https://faker.readthedocs.io/en/master/#localization

faker_config.title: Faker Configuration
faker_config.description: Config for the [`Faker`](https://faker.readthedocs.io/en/master/) instance variable `fake` used within map expressions. Only applicable if the plugin specifies `faker` as an additional dependency (through the `singer-sdk` `faker` extra or directly).

flattening_enabled.title: Enable Schema Flattening
flattening_enabled.description: 'True' to enable schema flattening and automatically expand nested properties.

flattening_max_depth.title: Max Flattening Depth
flattening_max_depth.description: The max depth to flatten schemas.

flattening_max_key_length.title: Max Key Length
flattening_max_key_length.description: The maximum length of a flattened key.

flattening_separator.title: Flattening Separator
flattening_separator.description: The separator to use when flattening keys.
